expectations.text: lists_many_skills: Response mentions at least 10 distinct skill names
expectations.evidence: Lists 40+ skills across all categories (docx, pdf, xlsx, pptx, canvas-design, algorithmic-art, code-review, vercel:deploy, etc.)

expectations.text: groups_by_category: Response organizes skills into at least 2 named groups or categories
expectations.evidence: 7 named groups: Document & File Skills, Design & Creative Skills, Code & Development Skills, Browser & Automation Skills, Writing & Communication Skills, Project & Config Skills, Vercel Skills

expectations.text: includes_invocation_guidance: Response explains how to invoke a skill (mentions slash commands or /skill-name pattern)
expectations.evidence: Dedicated 'How to invoke a skill' section with /skill-name code block, 3 examples, and note about natural language invocation

expectations.text: mentions_vercel_family: Response acknowledges the vercel:* family of skills (doesn't silently omit them)
expectations.evidence: Full 'Vercel Skills' section listing all 30 vercel:* skills individually with descriptions
